I've written the first prover batch: three briefs, the lane's `state.md` and the epic issue. The commit is local only (1992041): the push to `develop` was rejected because other sessions had pushed, so the driver needs to rebase and push.

**Figure today:** 965 of 1,821 indexes proved (53 %) and 560 of 1,381 arithmetic steps (41 %). This comes from `nikaia check --bounds` run on each `tools/*.nika` file on its own, and it is too low to quote: that check refuses 227 of the 246 files, because it can't see the types defined in the other files, so sites in that code drop out of the count. Getting a true figure is the first brief.

**Defect found:** an `assert` inside a loop body is never asked through the loop it stands in, although ADR-361 D2 says it should be. `while i < n { assert(i >= 0); i += 1 }` is refused, but the same claim after the loop is proved. With `prove-through-loops:on`, the compiler's own index and overflow checks inside a loop body stay unproved too. Most unproved checks sit inside loops; 281 of the unproved arithmetic steps are `x += 1` counters.

**One correction to your reading:** the certificate checker moves after the loop fix and the counter work, not first, because its unproved sites are counters and indexes inside loops.

**Batch, in order** (`docs/briefs/prover/batch.txt`, all builder on Opus):
1. `p1-1053-measure.md`: a `nikaia lower-std --bounds` flag that counts each file the way the package is lowered, plus `scripts/proved.nika` to sum the counts. The real figure then goes into `docs/formal-verification.md`.
2. `p2-1054-in-loop-claims.md`: fixes the loop defect above.
3. `p3-1053-reasons.md`: today 1,580 of 1,677 unproved sites share one catch-all reason; this splits it by how the unbounded name was bound (counter, `if` value, parameter, value read from a list, length of another list). That table decides the next prover extension.

I probed every claim in the briefs on today's binary.
